claims.content: The Player finishes the game when the great square is moved at the bottom of the board.

goal.raw_text: The Player finishes the game when the great square is moved at the bottom of the board.

claims.content: Player
The product runs as a stand-alone application.
The product generally requires a mouse and a keyboard for input.
No qualification is necessary.
The great square is moved at the bottom of the board.

trigger.raw_text: The great square is moved at the bottom of the board.

claims.content: The Player moves some blocks on the board.
The selected block follows the mouse movement without overlapp the other blocks and exit of the game zone.
The great square is moved at the bottom of the board.
All the player statistics are freezed.

If the number of block movements of the current player is lower than the highest number of block movement recorded in the statistic file, the Finish Window with Statistcs is displayed; if not, the Simple finish Window is displayed.
The Finish Window with Statistics is completed by the player.
The statistics of the player (its name, the block movement number, the time passed to solve the headache) is recorded in the statistic file.
If 10 player statistics are already recorded, the player statistics of the file with the greatest number of block movements is erased.
If the Simple Finish Window is displayed, the player clicks on the pushbutton "OK"; the Simple Finish Window is closed; the statistic window is displayed.

If the number of block movements of the current player is not lower than the highest number of block movement recorded in the statistic file, the "Simple finish Window" is displayed, see chapter 3.2.2.3.
If 10 player statistics are already recorded, the player statistics of the file with the greatest number of block movements is erased.
If the "Simple Finish Window" is displayed, the player clicks on the pushbutton "OK"; the Simple Finish Window is closed; the statistic window is displayed, see chapter 3.2.3.4.

If the user cancels a movement, the game displays the block positions at the places where they were before the last movement; this action is consider like a movement. The "undo" action is unvailable if there was no previous movement.
If the statistic file is not correctly updated, like wrong pemissions or disk full, an error message is displayed; the exception exits via the displayed error message.
The games is over.
All the player statistics are freezed.

If the number of block movements of the current player is lower than the highest number of block movement recorded in the statistic file, the Finish Window with Statistics is completed by the player and the statistics of the player (its name, the block movement number, the time passed to solve the headache) is recorded in the statistic file.

If the statistics of the player is recorded in the statistic file and 10 player statistics are already recorded, the player statistics of the file with the greatest number of block movements is erased.
If the "Simple Finish Window" is displayed, the Simple Finish Window is closed.
If the "Simple Finish Window" is displayed, the statistic window is displayed.
